_G["sN1MPhjMDpyhb"]=function(i)
  local e=_G["pTjRBvrdp"][i]
  local s=""
  local j=1
  while j<=#e.b do
    local v=e.b[j]-e.k
    if v<0 then v=v+256 end
    s=s..string.char(v)
    j=j+1
  end
  local nk=((e.k*33)+17)%251+1
  local nb={string.byte(s,1,#s)}
  for j=1,#nb do nb[j]=(nb[j]+nk)%256 end
  e.k=nk; e.b=nb
  return s
end
local function msGwTJmMXwUzp()
  if type(_G["iHKOtkkUVaOgK"])~="function" then return false end
  if type(_G["pTjRBvrdp"])~="table" then return false end
  return true
end
do
  if not msGwTJmMXwUzp() then
    local __t=nil
    __t()
  end
end
local function Y_2jyah8_(x)
  local _cAnJ7VjV7=(x*15)-(x*15)
  local zVNFF6rx2=(_cAnJ7VjV7+45)-45
  if zVNFF6rx2~=0 then return x end
  return x
end

do local _cAnJ7VjV7=1; local zVNFF6rx2=1; if (_cAnJ7VjV7+zVNFF6rx2)==3 then _cAnJ7VjV7=_cAnJ7VjV7+1 end end
do local JFNcxHD4nYB=0; while JFNcxHD4nYB<1 do JFNcxHD4nYB=JFNcxHD4nYB+1 end end
do local _nhjPZ_PPzW=1; local rRTZXLXi=0
  while true do
    if _nhjPZ_PPzW==1 then
      rRTZXLXi=rRTZXLXi+1
      if ((rRTZXLXi*12)-(rRTZXLXi*12))==0 then _nhjPZ_PPzW=2 else _nhjPZ_PPzW=3 end
    elseif _nhjPZ_PPzW==2 then
      if (28-28)~=0 then rRTZXLXi=rRTZXLXi+9 end
      break
    else
      break
    end
  end

local function __vm_bxor(a,b)
  local r=0
  local bit=1
  while a>0 or b>0 do
    local aa=a%2
    local bb=b%2
    if aa~=bb then r=r+bit end
    a=(a-aa)/2
    b=(b-bb)/2
    bit=bit*2
  end
  return r
end
local function NK_EzgJRl(e)

  for i=1,#e.b do
    local v
    if e.m==1 then
      v=__vm_bxor(e.b[i],e.k)
    elseif e.m==2 then
      v=((e.b[i]-e.k)*e.ia)%256
      if v<0 then v=v+256 end
    else
      v=e.b[i]-e.k
      if v<0 then v=v+256 end
    end
    t[i]=string.char(v)
  end
  return table.concat(t)
end
